heading: Account {name}
unreachable: The mail server's management API is unreachable. Check that the server is running and the panel is configured.
unavailable: Could not complete the change. Please try again.
configManaged: This account is declared in the server's configuration file. Its name, password and two-factor setting can only be changed there.
displayNameHelp: The sender name of mail sent through the API. Leave it empty to clear it.
displayNameControl: Remove the control characters and line breaks.
passwordHelp: 12 to 64 printable ASCII characters. The new password applies at once and the old one stops working.
passwordCharset: Use printable ASCII characters only: letters, digits, spaces and common punctuation.
passwordRefused: The server refused this password. It may be on a list of known breached passwords; choose another.
totpHelp: The panel cannot tell whether it is on. A new secret replaces any current one and applies at once: the account needs a code from it to sign in, so add it to an authenticator app straight away.
totpEnrollConfirm: Generate a new two-factor secret for {name}? It replaces any current one and applies at once.
totpSecretWarning: This is the only time the secret is shown. Add it to an authenticator app now.
mailboxesEmpty: This account has no mailboxes yet.
maskedHelp: Addresses that deliver to this account and can be removed without touching the real one.
maskedEmpty: This account has no masked addresses.
maskedRemoveConfirm: Remove {address}? Mail sent to it will no longer arrive. This cannot be undone.
maskedLimit: This account has reached its limit of masked addresses. Remove one first.
labelNeedsLetter: Include at least one letter or digit.
labelControl: Remove the control characters and line breaks.
archiveHelp: Messages deleted from this account that the server still keeps.
archiveUnavailable: The archive is not available: the server keeps no deleted mail, or nothing has been deleted from this account.
refusedGone: The account or the item no longer exists.
